editorial:
Ever felt like you didn't have a place to go during the holidays? You will really feel for the characters in this story. It follows a group of gay and lesbian guests who all gather at a special home to spend Christmas together. Instead of the usual family stress, you get a mix of new friendships and old heartaches. The vibe is cozy but a bit sad at times, as everyone is searching for a sense of belonging and love while the snow falls outside. It feels like a warm hug and a cry all at once.

What really makes this work is how natural the acting feels. You will love the chemistry between the guests as they open up to each other. While the pacing is a bit slow in the middle, the emotional payoff at the end is totally worth it. If you want something heartfelt, you should definitely check this out. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or stream it on Prime Video. If you are a fan of owning movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: As the holiday comes to a close, the guests realize that they have created their own chosen family. The tension between the main characters clears up after a series of honest talks. You see them embracing the joy of the season together, knowing they are not alone in the world. The movie wraps up with a hopeful feeling, showing that love and acceptance can be found in the most unexpected places and people.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cozy holiday stories about finding family.
